collection.description: A violent shaking damages some of the village's buildings, and the builders have work to do.
approximations: one structure is damaged (10-100%), the engine's pick; the owner's 25% each, at least one, needs a per-structure roll the format lacks
the structures it may damage are the engine's 'any' (the owner's lists exclude the puzzle buildings and New Believers' nursery: the engine's own damage rules)
every puzzle of the game's Puzzles screen is required (the patcher's lists: 15 in A New Home, 16 in the others but New Believers' 11); the 'one finished hut' requirement is not checked

start.text: One morning, the village becomes wracked with a violent shaking. Things start flying off shelves, pottery smashes on the floor, and everyone starts taking cover under nearby structures. The villagers are frightened, but luckily, no one is hurt. A lot of loose rubble is strewn about and some structures have been visibly damaged. It looks like the builders have more work cut out for them.
